evaluation.selection: More validation greedy wins, then sampled wins, then higher mean winning HP fraction, then earlier checkpoint; keep the unchanged initializer eligible.

historical_guide_archive.preserves: Training guide bytes bound by the original specialist dataset evidence; that historical evidence was not repinned.

hp.accounting: Exact-action verification replays are additional engine work, not new training data or independent policy evaluation samples.

semantics.boss_hp: Retained Vantom combat owner at the recorded endpoint. Loss includes simultaneous lethal cases even if boss HP is zero. Cutoffs are separate.
semantics.conditional: Loss-only and win-only means change population between checkpoints. Paired both-lost/both-won comparisons hold case and sampled-action repeat fixed; these are outcome-conditioned descriptive diagnostics.
semantics.player_hp: Retained combat.player at combat end, before run victory cleanup; fraction uses its own terminal max_hp.
semantics.player_post_cleanup_hp: Existing native terminal CombatSummary after victory hooks; fraction uses its own max_hp.
semantics.selection: HP diagnostics do not change the frozen checkpoint-selection rule, rewards, or training.
semantics.source: Exact recorded actions replayed through unchanged native adapter with every public state, execution, combat summary and reward checked. No new policy decisions or statistical samples.
semantics.uncertainty: Exploratory, post-hoc diagnostics from one learner. Source-campaign bootstrap resamples all selected repeats together. No proof of unwinnable cases, optimal play, or fresh-test improvement.

inspector.limitations: All42validationopenings and all outcomes retained per selected checkpoint, greedy only. Inspector canonical campaign cutoff labels are separate from confirmed combat outcomes. No private snapshots or RNG enter the viewer; combat win curves are in MLflow.

limits: One warm-started learner, repeated development selection, and a small validation population; no fresh-test improvement claim.
Source routes and inventories depend on surviving the fixed collector prefix. Saved later turns are correlated training starts.
Warm start, critic calibration, focused data and PPO settings were changed together; this experiment does not isolate their causal contributions.
Greedy win-rate and paired HP bootstrap intervals include zero. Reported HP progress does not prove any state unwinnable or any action optimal.
Other bosses, full Act 1 retention and a scratch-trained specialist were not measured.
Health curves are exact-replay derivatives for this study; native training/public schemas and reward definitions are unchanged.

lineage.initialization: Actor-preserving value-head-only calibration on TRAIN returns, then fresh specialist PPO optimizer and RNG. Exact native resumes only within this new phase.
lineage.interpretation: Warm start from rich combat 250k PPO + 8k imitation; native PPO counters measure only this new specialist phase. Count 4096 calibration environment decisions separately. Teacher pool has 1M unique ancestral PPO decisions.

next_recommendation: Repeat this fixed specialist protocol with another learner seed before treating the improvement as reliable or opening the reserved test.
objective: Test whether focused Vantom practice improves a warm-started combat actor; retain within-fight HP diagnostics alongside win rate.

timings.note: Stage timings may overlap. No separate implementation/review/publication wall-time estimate is invented; the independent review receipt records its available timing.

training.calibration_fit: Fixed 400 updates on an 80% source-campaign subset of TRAIN; the remaining TRAIN subset monitors calibration, not model selection.
training.sampler: Uniform source fight; opening/continuation equally when both exist; uniform saved later turn. No new success filter.
